step1_analysis.description: A lumped-element passive network representing the LC tank or split inductor of a millimeter-wave VCO. It determines the oscillation frequency and phase noise performance of the circuit.

paper_reference.title: A 33.6-to-46.2GHz 32nm CMOS VCO with 177.5dBc/Hz Minimum Noise FOM Using Inductor Splitting for Tuning Extension

resonance_frequency.description: The frequency at which the tank's reactive components cancel out, setting the VCO's operating frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_res = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L1 * C2)). With L1=100pH and C2=150fF, f_res is approximately 41 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported operating frequency range for the VCO.

peak_impedance.description: The parallel equivalent resistance (Rp) of the tank at resonance, which determines the required negative resistance and impacts efficiency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominated by the parallel resistor R1. Set to 500 ohms in the testbench.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A typical mm-wave LC tank has an Rp in the range of a few hundred ohms to support oscillation with reasonable power.

quality_factor.description: The Q-factor of the tank, which is critical for achieving the reported phase noise FOM.

sky130_expected.reasoning: High Q is required for good phase noise. On-chip mm-wave inductors typically achieve Q between 10 and 20.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the resonance frequency, peak impedance, and quality factor of the LC tank using a differential AC current drive.
step3_testbench.spice:
* LC Tank Characterization
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt
.param L1_val=100p C1_val=10f R1_val=500 R2_val=1k C2_val=150f

* DUT
L1 n0 n1 {L1_val}
C1 n0 n2 {C1_val}
R1 n0 n1 {R1_val}
R2 n1 n2 {R2_val}
C2 n0 n1 {C2_val}

* Ground connection for n2
Vgnd n2 0 DC 0

* Differential AC drive
I1 n0 0 AC 0.5
I2 n1 0 AC -0.5

.control
ac dec 100 1G 100G

let Z_mag = mag(v(n0) - v(n1))
let Z_phase = 180/PI * cph(v(n0) - v(n1))

meas ac Z_peak max Z_mag
meas ac f_res when Z_phase=0 fall=1

let Z_3dB = Z_peak / 1.41421356
meas ac f_low when Z_mag=Z_3dB rise=1
meas ac f_high when Z_mag=Z_3dB fall=1

meas ac Q_tank param='f_res / (f_high - f_low)'

print f_res Z_peak Q_tank
quit
.endc
